what: Pin the section and scroll, and the big name list rolls up inside the window so the current row sits at the window center. Rows fade by distance from center: within .5 is 1, within 1.5 is .5, within 2.5 is .25, within 3.5 is .1, beyond that .05 (.3s transition). When the current item comes within .15 rows of center, the paired pane (background photo and description) switches to that item’s over .4s. 300px of scroll per row, scrub .1, snaps to each row.

options.[data-fx-part=window]: Window showing the list (overflow hidden) — it needs a height
options.[data-fx-part=item]: A single line — heights must match
options.[data-fx-part=pane]: (Optional) one stacked panel per step. Paired with rows in order within the same parent (several groups are possible, like a background photo group and a description group)
options.levels: Five opacities by distance (center, 1, 2, 3, beyond), default 1,.5,.25,.1,.05
options.snap: If false, does not pause on each line
options.from: Minimum width to switch on (px), default 992 — below that the list stays as is and only the first panel shows

from.where: index.html .rv-brands (client name dial — original brands-section · brands-list · brand-bg · brand-content)
